title: Dynamic typing
prompt_markdown: Which statement best describes Python variables?

choices: Names bind to objects and may be rebound
content.explanation: Names bind to objects; objects carry types.

title: None comparison
prompt_markdown: What is the idiomatic check for absence?

content.explanation: None is a singleton and is checked by identity.

title: Strong typing
prompt_markdown: Explain why Python is called dynamically but strongly typed.

rubric: Names may be rebound at runtime
content.reference_answer: Names can reference objects of different types over time, while operations between incompatible objects usually raise an error rather than silently coercing.

title: Boundary conversion
prompt_markdown: Why should an API convert and validate a numeric string at its input boundary?

content.reference_answer: Convert external text immediately so invalid values fail predictably at the boundary and internal code works with the intended type.

content.explanation: Strings are immutable; methods return new values.
